mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the lettuce wick was most worthwhile: it showed how a bed can draw solution without a pump while still leaving air around the roots.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the hooded lamp felt least informative on its own; its purpose only became clear after mounting it.

surprise.text: The hose served as a sleeve to hold the wick in place without pinching it, rather than carrying water itself.

arbitrary.text: The felt and hose combination was initially a guess because their intended roles were not clear until the result.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the plants and station fare through the storm and what happens to the specimens, though this chapter's actions became fairly predictable once the watering choices were made.
